statement_map.email_excerpt: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and a test form you filled in from another email address delivered the email.
We explained that emails can sometimes go to spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea, and that you can do this in the email domain section of Settings.
You mentioned that you planned to verify your sender domain in the email domain section of Settings the morning after our call.
